decisions.decision: Use OPA's compact count-card hierarchy for the unselected workspace, spanning conversation and contact columns while preserving the queue. Show only canonical RLS-scoped counts for Fila, Minhas, Automático and Fechadas; shortcuts clear auxiliary filters to match their unfiltered counts. Unknown/error is not zero. Reuse query cache, Button, icons, search and keyboard-help dialog. Desktop Conversas returns to overview; mobile still opens directly on the queue. No synthetic charts, time metrics, status or new claim behavior.

Adopt the live OPA reference's centered identity, compact IXC association, full-width profile action and separated operational metadata. Reuse Avatar and the authorized contact-avatar endpoint; preserve initials without a photo. Add explicit phone-copy feedback. Keep demands and conversation tags visible; fold empty secondary context with native keyboard-accessible details, expanding errors and populated working sections. Preserve all existing links, mutations, permissions and responsive contact sheet. No fabricated protocol, new backend or OPA assets.

Reuse MessageBubble, MediaRenderer and DocumentCard inside a shared MessageFrame: recorded sender above content, decorative generic avatar outside, 8px slate bubbles, semantic timestamps and responsive widths. Keep existing read receipts, failures, edits, citations, notes and menus. Webchat uses recorded sender_name, never today's assignee; unknown authors stay Atendente. PDF links use the same HTTPS validation as the public portal. No transport, API or database change.
decisions.reference: Live OPA conversation inspected read-only: external avatars and author labels, compact bubbles, corner timestamps and media cards. Keep local icons and organization theme; no OPA assets. 21st search unavailable without login; existing primitives reused.

decisions.decision: Separate identity and contact tools from the wrapping service-action row, preserving visible action labels instead of copying OPA menus. Keep the canonical owner/status/channel sources, permissions, hooks and confirmations. Use existing brand tokens and icons; no new runtime dependency or business rule.

Use the live OPA operator screen inspected in Chrome as the primary reference, ahead of the supplied clone. Prioritize vertical queues, compact filters and text-first ticket rows. Keep all CRM semantics and organization-controlled accents.
decisions.implementation: InboxRail presents the existing InboxFilters tabs and TopBar tools through portals, one mounted instance per control. Desktop uses vertical keyboard navigation; mobile returns the same tabs to the list. Sidebar expansion exposes the full permission-filtered catalog. Filters collapse without clearing and show an active count. No fabricated protocol, metrics, new backend, or OPA assets.

decisions.decision: Use the customer-provided OPA Suite clone as visual reference: compact navigation rail, visible queues, neutral cool surfaces and distinct conversation/contact panels. Retain configured brand accents, light/dark preferences, all existing navigation, permissions and business actions. Public login and customer webchat remain unchanged.
decisions.reference: User-provided OPASUITE ENG REVERSA/opasuite-clone/src/styles.css and src/App.tsx, demo rendered locally on 2026-10-13
decisions.implementation: Reuse local Radix/shadcn components and canonical icons. Match wide-screen side panels (351px / 347px), slate bubbles, 32px dotted conversation background, flatter contact profile and compact queue strip. Retain brand accents on actions and selections. No new runtime dependencies, third-party assets, backend integration or remote fonts. Scope visual tokens to the mounted operator shell.
decisions.constraint: 21st catalog search requires authentication unavailable in this session; use the supplied reference, not guessed catalog components.
